entries.text: --official now enforces the full TPC-H and TPC-DS specification: it refuses a missing seed, query subsets, partial phases and stream counts below the specification minimum for the scale factor, and TPC-H runs must enable the refresh functions.

benchbox submit records plan tier, preview features, vendor permission, vendor notice and self-run attestation in the submission manifest, and the validator refuses free-tier, trial and preview results without the vendor's permission.
TPC-DI result output no longer labels a run as official or compliant and carries the derived-results disclaimer.
